selection.forecastCriterion: development event-macro 5/10/20 s position RMSE; no holdout truth used
selection.policyCriterion: development mean contact, then return failures, then hold; nominal regret cap 0.5 s

definitions.contact: strict interior of physical synthetic radius plus 1 m margin; swept piecewise-linear intersection, truth knots every 0.25 s
definitions.warning: stationary predicted margin-boundary first entry, not center arrival
definitions.birth: instant onset of small visible radius 15%, grows to nominal in 4 s; astronaut stationary sampling rock before alarm
definitions.delivery: sensor timestamp +1 s common processing allowance; frames only observed on 2 s control ticks
definitions.reaction: after first delivered fix; all arms including Oracle identical
definitions.estimateReady: second delivered fix; first-fix radial fallback permitted after reaction, not four-second mandatory hold
definitions.sensor: fixed virtual external position network, no range/occlusion model; latency/dropout assumptions; not monocular vision
definitions.return: same terrain graph, speed and load, same oxygen/battery budgets; return point is NOT shelter
definitions.oracle: same alarm/resources and finite candidate bank with exact future path; not global optimum
definitions.terrainEffects: DEM limits walker. Direction forcing is synthetic/terrestrial analog, no validated rock-scale Mars CFD
definitions.independence: 54 held-out synthetic cases, not 54 actual events. Wind windows are only three held-out Earth days. Existing NASA image clips already used in earlier releases; retrospective diagnostic only.
definitions.holdout: unseen sensor seeds, unseen gust/oscillatory families, wind days 4–6; code defects must be logged and entire set rerun under a new filename
